description: This file defines a PHP class 'LeavePeriodHistoryDecorator' within the OrangeHRM project. The class acts as a decorator for the 'LeavePeriodHistory' entity, adding functionalities such as formatted date retrieval. It uses a trait for date formatting and encapsulates the LeavePeriodHistory object to provide enhanced behaviors.
